output.summary: A large evergreen fruit tree native from Pakistan to Malesia, probably originating around western Indo-Burma. Its irregularly shaped fruit has bright orange flesh surrounding a large, flat stone. Unripe mangoes are used for pickles and chutneys, while ripe mangoes are widely eaten as fruit.
output.edibilityNote: Unripe mangoes are used in pickles and chutneys; ripe mangoes are widely eaten as fruit.
